card.name: Words after negation or reduction cues
card.fires_on: Ordinary English words that follow a negating or reducing word such as not, avoid, reduce, minimize, skip, or worse, and that start or continue a phrase about what is avoided or lessened.

modes.label: After not or avoid
modes.description: The marked word follows not, avoid or skip in an instruction or warning.

modes.label: After reduce or minimize
modes.description: The marked word follows a verb of lessening and begins the thing being reduced.
modes.example: will also help to minimize<< habitat>> fragmentation effects.

modes.label: Comparative or contrast phrases
modes.description: The marked word completes a phrase that signals a worse or higher outcome.
modes.example: found they were worse<< off>> financially as a result of Castro’s policies
